gaps.line: His mother runs through the airport and shouts his ___.
The old neighbour is not scary; he is just ___.
Kevin puts water on the stairs, and it becomes ___.
Harry and Marv watch the house from a white ___.
Kevin listens to the old man talk about his ___.
gaps.hint: a male child in a family

quiz.q: How does Kevin get food while he is alone?
options: He buys it at the supermarket
He finds it in the attic
quiz.why: He goes shopping with his father's card and comes home with bags of food.

quiz.q: What does Kevin do to make the house look full?
options: He plays loud music and puts figures in the windows
He calls his whole family home
quiz.why: The music and the moving figures look like a party from outside.

quiz.q: What does Kevin's mother do when she learns he is alone?
options: She stays in Paris and waits
She turns back and takes any plane home
She sends the police to the house
quiz.why: She gives up her seat and travels home any way she can.

quotes.quote: Look what you did, you little jerk!
quotes.note: Uncle Frank says it at dinner, before the family leaves for Paris.

quotes.quote: I want my family back.
quotes.note: Kevin says it to a Santa in a shop, and it is the wish of the whole film.

truefalse.s: Kevin fights the burglars before his family leaves for Paris.
truefalse.fix: The family leaves first; the fight happens days later, when they are in Paris.

truefalse.s: Kevin's family flies to Paris without him.
Kevin is afraid of the old neighbour at the start of the film.
The burglars leave the house with the money at the end.
truefalse.fix: The police catch them in the house, and they lose everything.

truefalse.s: Kevin plays loud music and puts figures in the windows to make the house look full.
Kevin's mother stays in Paris and waits for news.
truefalse.fix: She turns back at once and travels home by any plane she can find.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Kevin want his family to disappear at the start?
shortAnswers.model: He is angry because his brother and the other children are unkind to him. He says it as a wish, not as a real plan.

shortAnswers.q: How does Kevin feel when he wakes up and the house is quiet?
shortAnswers.model: At first he is excited, because he can do what he wants all day. Later he feels lonely and afraid.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if you were alone at home for three days?
shortAnswers.model: I would lock the doors and call my parents every evening. I would not open the door to anyone.

shortAnswers.q: Why does the old neighbour help Kevin at the end?
shortAnswers.model: Kevin talks to him in the church and is not afraid of him. The old man wants to help the boy who was kind to him.

gaps.line: Woody is Andy's favourite toy and sleeps on his ___.
The toys in Andy's room move and talk when people ___.
Woody and Buzz get lost at a gas ___.
Andy's family goes to a restaurant called Pizza ___.
gaps.hint: a big round world in space

gaps.line: Buzz sees an advert on TV and learns the ___ about himself.

quiz.q: Why is the family packing boxes at the start?
options: They are moving to a new house
quiz.why: The family is moving, so every room is packed, including Andy's room.

quiz.q: Why is Woody angry with Buzz on the first night?
options: Andy puts Buzz on the bed instead of him
quiz.why: Buzz takes the place next to Andy, and Woody is not the favourite any more.

quiz.q: What do the other toys think when Buzz falls out of the window?
quiz.why: They see the two toys fighting, so they believe Woody did it.

quotes.quote: You are a sad, strange little man.
quotes.note: Woody says it to Buzz when Buzz still believes he is a real space ranger.

quotes.quote: I'm not a toy, I'm a space ranger!
quotes.note: Buzz says it many times before he sees the advert and learns the truth.

truefalse.s: Woody is the new toy in Andy's room.
truefalse.fix: Buzz is the new toy; Woody was Andy's favourite before he arrived.

truefalse.s: Buzz thinks he is a real space ranger at the start of the film.
Woody and Buzz get lost at the airport.
truefalse.fix: They get lost at a gas station during the family's move.

truefalse.s: Sid has a dog called Scud, and the dog is not friendly.
The other toys turn against Woody after Buzz disappears.
At the end Buzz and Woody are still angry with each other.
truefalse.fix: They become friends again after they escape from Sid's house.

shortAnswers.q: Why is Woody jealous of Buzz?
shortAnswers.model: Andy sleeps with Buzz and takes him everywhere, so Woody is no longer the favourite. Woody is afraid of losing his place.

shortAnswers.q: How does Buzz feel when he sees the advert for Buzz toys?
shortAnswers.model: He feels shocked and sad, because the advert shows many other Buzz toys like him. He understands that he is a toy.

shortAnswers.q: Why do the other toys stop trusting Woody?
shortAnswers.model: They see Buzz fall out of the window and think Woody pushed him. Woody is jealous, so it is easy to believe.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if your best friend got a new favourite toy?
shortAnswers.model: I would talk to my friend and tell them how I feel. I would not take the new toy away.

gaps.line: Marlin is very careful with Nemo because he lost his ___.
gaps.hint: the woman a man is married to

gaps.line: Dory forgets things very ___ and asks the same question again.
The fish in the tank live in a dentist's ___ in Sydney.
The turtles help Marlin ride the ocean ___ to Sydney.
A diver catches Nemo and takes him to a ___.

quiz.q: Why does Marlin leave the reef?
quiz.why: Nemo is taken by a diver, so Marlin swims across the ocean after him.

quiz.q: What name do the fish in the tank give Nemo?
quiz.why: They call him Sharkbait because they think he was caught near sharks.

quiz.q: How does Dory help Marlin find the address?
options: She reads it on the diver's mask
quiz.why: The mask falls into the water, and Dory reads the address on it.

quotes.quote: I am a nice shark, not a mindless eating machine.
quotes.note: Bruce says it at the sharks' meeting, where the sharks promise not to eat fish.

quotes.quote: Fish aren't meant to be in a box, kid.
quotes.note: Gill says it in the tank; he wants to go back to the ocean.

truefalse.s: Nemo has one small fin on one side of his body.
Dory is a shark who helps Marlin on his journey.
truefalse.fix: Dory is a blue fish with a short memory; the shark is called Bruce.

truefalse.s: Nemo is taken to a zoo in Sydney.
truefalse.fix: He is taken to a fish tank in a dentist's office in Sydney.

truefalse.s: The fish in the tank want to escape to the sea.
Marlin and Dory meet a turtle called Crush.
At the end Nemo stays in the dentist's tank for ever.
truefalse.fix: Nemo escapes and swims back to the reef with his father.

shortAnswers.q: Why is Marlin so careful with Nemo?
shortAnswers.model: He lost his wife and all his other eggs in an attack, so Nemo is the only family he has left.

shortAnswers.q: How does Nemo feel when his father talks to him at school?
shortAnswers.model: He feels angry and small, because his friends laugh at him. That is why he swims out to the boat.

shortAnswers.q: Why do the fish in the tank want to escape?
shortAnswers.model: They want to live in the ocean again, and they are afraid of Darla. The tank is too small for them.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if you were lost far from home?
shortAnswers.model: I would find a safe place and ask a friendly person for help. I would try to tell my family where I am.

gaps.line: Charlie lives in a small house with his mother and four ___.
gaps.hint: the parents of your mother or father

gaps.line: Mr. Bucket works in a factory and puts caps on ___.
gaps.hint: you clean your teeth with it

gaps.line: Wonka closes the factory because other people steal his ___.
Augustus eats too much chocolate and falls into the ___.
gaps.hint: a big natural line of water

gaps.line: Willy Wonka wants a child to take care of his ___.
gaps.hint: a place where things are made

quiz.q: Why does Wonka invite five children into his factory?
options: He wants to sell more chocolate
He is looking for a child to take over
quiz.why: He is getting older and wants the right child to run the factory one day.

quiz.q: What do the Oompa Loompas do when a child breaks a rule?
options: They sing a song about it
quiz.why: After every accident, the Oompa Loompas sing a song with a lesson in it.

quiz.q: What happens to Mike Teavee in the television room?
quiz.why: He sends himself by television and arrives tiny.

quotes.quote: Come with me and you'll be in a world of pure imagination.
quotes.note: Wonka sings it when the children enter the factory.

quotes.quote: So much time and so little to do. Strike that, reverse it.
quotes.note: Wonka says it at the start of the tour, and it shows how strange he is.

truefalse.s: Charlie's family is very poor and they eat soup every day.
Charlie finds the first golden ticket.
truefalse.fix: Charlie finds the last ticket, after four other children have found theirs.

truefalse.s: Willy Wonka makes all the chocolate himself.
truefalse.fix: The Oompa Loompas make the chocolate; Wonka invents the sweets.

truefalse.s: Veruca falls down a chute in the nut room.
Grandpa Joe goes with Charlie into the factory.
At the end Charlie goes to the factory alone and leaves his family.
truefalse.fix: Charlie says no to that plan, so Wonka invites the whole family.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Charlie open only one chocolate bar a year?
shortAnswers.model: His family has very little money, so a chocolate bar is a special present. He gets one for his birthday.

shortAnswers.q: How does Charlie feel when he finds the golden ticket?
shortAnswers.model: He cannot believe it, and he runs home to tell his family. He is excited but also worried about money.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Wonka choose Charlie and not the other children?
shortAnswers.model: Charlie is kind and honest, and he does not want to win at any price. He also cares about his family.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if you had one golden ticket?
shortAnswers.model: I would take my best friend or a family member with me. I would try every kind of chocolate in the factory.

gaps.line: Matilda reads every book in the library, and the librarian is ___.
Miss Honey has no money because the headmistress takes her ___.
Lavender hides a newt in the headmistress's ___.
Matilda can move a glass with her ___.
gaps.hint: the part of you that thinks

gaps.line: At the end Matilda lives with Miss Honey in a small ___.

quiz.q: Why do Matilda's parents not like her reading?
options: They think books are a waste of time
They want her to play sport
quiz.why: They watch television and think a girl should not sit with books all day.

quiz.q: How does Matilda answer the Trunchbull in class?
options: She answers back and is not afraid
quiz.why: Matilda stays calm and speaks the truth, and the Trunchbull hates it.

quiz.q: What does Matilda put in her father's hat?
quiz.why: She glues the hat to his head, and he has to cut his hair to get it off.

quotes.quote: Have you ever heard of the Chokey?
quotes.note: The headmistress says it to the children as a threat.

quotes.quote: I think I can move things with my mind.
quotes.note: Matilda tells her teacher about her new power.

truefalse.s: Matilda's parents are proud of her reading.
truefalse.fix: They think books are a waste of time and tell her to watch television instead.

truefalse.s: Miss Honey is Matilda's teacher.
The Trunchbull was a famous athlete before she ran the school.
Matilda's brother Michael is clever and reads many books.
truefalse.fix: Michael watches television and does not read; Matilda is the clever one.

truefalse.s: Lavender is Matilda's friend at school.
Matilda's parents take her with them when they leave the country.
truefalse.fix: They leave without her, and Miss Honey adopts her.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Matilda go to the library every day?
shortAnswers.model: Her house is noisy and nobody talks to her, so the library is quiet and full of stories. The librarian is kind to her.

shortAnswers.q: How does Matilda feel about her family?
shortAnswers.model: She is lonely and angry, because they do not listen to her. She finds a real family with Miss Honey.

shortAnswers.q: Why is the Trunchbull so cruel to children?
shortAnswers.model: She hates children and she likes to control everyone. She is also afraid of anyone who is not afraid of her.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if a teacher was unkind to you?
shortAnswers.model: I would tell my parents and another teacher. I would not stay silent, because it is not my fault.

gaps.line: Mr. Brown is not happy about a bear in his ___.
gaps.hint: the building where a family lives

gaps.line: Paddington tries to wash, and the bathroom becomes very ___.
Millicent wants to put Paddington in a ___.
gaps.hint: a place with old and rare things

gaps.line: An earthquake destroys the bears' home, so Paddington travels to ___.
Paddington has a special sandwich recipe from his ___.
gaps.hint: the sister of your mother or father

quiz.q: Why does Paddington come to London?
options: His home in Peru is destroyed
quiz.why: An earthquake destroys the bears' home, and Aunt Lucy sends him to England.

quiz.q: Why is Mr. Brown not sure about the bear at first?
options: He likes a quiet, tidy house
quiz.why: Mr. Brown likes his routine and his clean house, and a bear brings both danger and mess.

quiz.q: What happens when Paddington has a bath?
quiz.why: He does not understand the taps, and the water runs through the floor.

quotes.quote: Can we keep him, please?
quotes.note: The children want the bear to stay from the first day.

quotes.quote: What a magnificent specimen.
quotes.note: Millicent is a taxidermist, and she says it about the bear.

truefalse.s: Paddington arrives in London at a train station.
The Browns find Paddington at the airport.
truefalse.fix: They find him at Paddington station, which is where his name comes from.

truefalse.s: Paddington's name comes from the station where the Browns found him.
Mr. Brown wants the bear to stay from the first minute.
truefalse.fix: Mr. Brown is not sure at first; the children want him to stay at once.

truefalse.s: Paddington likes marmalade and keeps a sandwich under his hat.
Millicent is a kind neighbour who helps the Browns.
truefalse.fix: Millicent is a taxidermist who wants to put Paddington in her collection.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Paddington leave Peru?
shortAnswers.model: An earthquake destroys the home he shares with his aunt, so she sends him to London to find a safe home.

shortAnswers.q: How does Paddington feel on his first night in London?
shortAnswers.model: He is excited but also lonely and confused, because the city is loud and nobody stops to help him.

shortAnswers.q: Why does the Brown family change their mind about Paddington?
shortAnswers.model: He is polite and kind, and he helps them without asking for anything. They see that he needs a family.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if you found a stranger alone at a station?
shortAnswers.model: I would ask if they need help and then call an adult or the police. I would not leave them alone.

gaps.line: Dorothy lives on a farm with Aunt Em and Uncle ___.
gaps.hint: the man's name in the film

gaps.line: The Tin Man carries an axe and wants a ___.
gaps.hint: the part of you that feels love

gaps.line: The Cowardly Lion is afraid of everything and wants ___.
gaps.hint: being brave when you are afraid

gaps.line: Toto opens the curtain and shows that the Wizard is a ___.
gaps.hint: not a wizard, not a monster

gaps.line: The Wicked Witch sends flying ___ to catch Dorothy.

quiz.q: Why does Dorothy run away from home?
options: Her aunt is angry with her
Miss Gulch wants to take Toto
She wants to see the Wizard
quiz.why: Miss Gulch takes Toto away, so Dorothy runs away to save her dog.

quiz.q: Why do the Munchkins celebrate when Dorothy arrives?
quiz.why: Dorothy's house lands on the Wicked Witch of the East and kills her.

quiz.q: Why can the Wizard not help Dorothy at first?
options: He is not a real wizard
quiz.why: He is an ordinary man with machines, and he hides behind a curtain.

quotes.quote: Toto, I've a feeling we're not in Kansas anymore.
quotes.note: Dorothy says it just after she lands in Oz and sees the colours.

quotes.quote: I'm melting! Oh, what a world!
quotes.note: The Witch says it when Dorothy throws water over her.

truefalse.s: Dorothy's house lands on the Wicked Witch of the North.
truefalse.fix: It lands on the Wicked Witch of the East, and her ruby slippers go to Dorothy.

truefalse.s: The Scarecrow, the Tin Man and the Lion travel with Dorothy to the Emerald City.
The Wizard of Oz is a real wizard with great power.
truefalse.fix: He is an ordinary man who hides behind a curtain and uses machines.

truefalse.s: The Lion is afraid for most of the film.
Aunt Em and Uncle Henry go to Oz with Dorothy.
truefalse.fix: They stay in Kansas; only Dorothy and Toto make the journey.

truefalse.s: Dorothy wakes up in bed at the end and tells her family about Oz.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Dorothy want to leave Kansas at the start?
shortAnswers.model: She feels lonely on the farm and dreams of a beautiful place far away. Miss Gulch also wants to take her dog.

shortAnswers.q: How do the three friends become braver during the journey?
shortAnswers.model: They help each other when there is danger. The Scarecrow thinks, the Tin Man cares, and the Lion protects them.

shortAnswers.q: Why does the Wizard ask for the witch's broomstick?
shortAnswers.model: He wants her to do something very difficult so he does not have to help her. He hopes she will fail and go away.

shortAnswers.q: What would you ask the Wizard of Oz for?
shortAnswers.model: I would ask for more confidence, because I am shy when I speak in front of people. I would also ask for a safe journey home.

gaps.line: Elliott hides E.T. in his bedroom and tells nobody his ___.
The children dress E.T. as a ___ for Halloween.
E.T. is ill, and Elliott feels ___ too.
Elliott and his brother ride bikes to help E.T. go ___.
The plant in the pot comes back to ___ at the end.

quiz.q: Why does Elliott take E.T. into his room?
options: He wants to hide him from the adults
quiz.why: He knows that grown-ups will take the alien away, so he keeps him in his bedroom.

quiz.q: Why does E.T. become ill?
options: He cannot live on Earth without help from home
quiz.why: He is far from his people and his body cannot stay healthy on Earth.

quiz.q: Why do the boys take a van at the end?
options: To help E.T. escape to the forest
quiz.why: They need to get E.T. out of the house and to the meeting place in the forest.

quotes.quote: You could be happy here. I could take care of you.
quotes.note: Elliott says it when E.T. wants to go home, and it shows how much he will miss him.

quotes.quote: Ouch!
quotes.note: E.T. learns the word from the children and uses it a lot.

truefalse.s: Elliott finds E.T. in the garden shed.
E.T. can speak English well from the first night.
truefalse.fix: He says only a few words at first and learns more from the children.

truefalse.s: Michael is Elliott's little sister.
truefalse.fix: Michael is Elliott's older brother; Gertie is the little sister.

truefalse.s: E.T. becomes ill before the children help him escape.
The children escape from the agents on flying bicycles.
At the end E.T. stays on Earth with Elliott.
truefalse.fix: He says goodbye and leaves in his spaceship, and Elliott is sad but happy for him.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Elliott hide E.T. from the adults?
shortAnswers.model: He is afraid that they will take the alien away or hurt him. He wants to protect his new friend.

shortAnswers.q: How does Elliott feel when E.T. is ill?
shortAnswers.model: He feels weak and sick too, because they are connected. He is also frightened that his friend will die.

shortAnswers.q: Why is it difficult for E.T. to go home?
shortAnswers.model: He needs to build a machine to call his people, and he cannot find all the parts. The scientists also want to catch him.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if you found an alien in your garden?
shortAnswers.model: I would tell one adult I trust and help the alien hide. I would try to find out what it needs before calling anyone.

gaps.line: Gru has many machines and a lot of small yellow ___.
The three girls live in an orphanage and want a ___.
Gru does not want to read the girls a bedtime ___.
The girls sell cookies at the door of Vector's ___.
Gru plans to make the moon small with a shrink ___.

quiz.q: Why does Gru want to steal the moon?
quiz.why: He wants to be famous as the best villain in the world.

quiz.q: How does Gru get into Vector's house?
options: He sends the girls to sell cookies and sneaks in
quiz.why: Vector opens the door for the girls, and Gru goes in behind them.

quiz.q: What happens at the girls' dance show?
options: Gru is late and then stands up to dance with them
quiz.why: He runs to the show, gives a funny dance and makes the girls laugh.

quotes.quote: Light bulb.
quotes.note: Gru says it when he has a new idea, and it becomes his catchphrase.

quotes.quote: Freeze ray!
quotes.note: Gru uses his freeze ray on people who are in his way.

truefalse.s: Gru wants to steal the moon to give it to Vector.
truefalse.fix: He wants it to become the greatest villain, and Vector steals his shrink ray.

truefalse.s: The three girls come from an orphanage.
Vector lives in a big white house with many cameras and traps.
Agnes is the oldest of the three girls.
truefalse.fix: Margo is the oldest; Agnes is the youngest.

truefalse.s: The girls ask Gru to come to their dance show.
At the end Gru flies away with the moon and leaves the girls.
truefalse.fix: He saves the girls first, and the moon goes back into the sky.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Gru adopt three girls?
shortAnswers.model: He needs them to get inside Vector's house, because they sell cookies at his door. He does not plan to be a father.

shortAnswers.q: How does Gru change during the film?
shortAnswers.model: At first he only thinks about his plan and his name. Then he starts to care about the girls and wants to be with them.

shortAnswers.q: Why is the dance show important to Gru?
shortAnswers.model: The girls want him there, and he chooses them instead of his plan. That is the moment he becomes a father.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if a villain asked you to help him?
shortAnswers.model: I would say no and tell someone safe. I would not go into a stranger's house, even for a good reason.

gaps.line: Elsa wears gloves because she is afraid of her ___.
Anna and Hans decide to marry after one ___.
Kristoff is an ice seller, and his best friend is a ___.
Elsa builds a big ice palace on the top of a ___.
Olaf likes warm ___ and dreams about summer.

quiz.q: Why do the castle gates stay closed for years?
options: Elsa is afraid people will see her magic
quiz.why: After the accident with Anna, the family hides Elsa and her power.

quiz.q: Why does Anna go after Elsa?
options: She wants to bring her sister home and stop the winter
She wants to see the ice palace
quiz.why: Elsa's magic has frozen the kingdom, and only Elsa can stop it.

quiz.q: Why does Kristoff take Anna to the trolls?
options: He hopes they can cure her frozen heart
quiz.why: Her heart is frozen, and the trolls are the only ones who may know how to help.

quotes.quote: I like warm hugs!
quotes.note: The snowman says it when he meets Anna, and it is why everybody loves him.

quotes.quote: For the first time in forever.
quotes.note: Anna sings it on coronation day, when the gates finally open.

truefalse.s: Elsa's magic turns the water of the fjord into ice.
Anna has ice powers too.
truefalse.fix: Only Elsa has the power; Anna is an ordinary girl.

truefalse.s: Hans helps Anna because he loves her.
truefalse.fix: Hans only wants the throne, and he leaves Anna alone in the cold.

truefalse.s: Kristoff is an ice harvester and Sven is his reindeer.
The Duke of Weselton is afraid of Elsa's magic.
Olaf melts at the end and disappears for ever.
truefalse.fix: Elsa makes a small snow cloud for him, so Olaf stays alive.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Elsa stay away from Anna for years?
shortAnswers.model: She is afraid she will hurt her sister again with her magic. She thinks that staying away keeps Anna safe.

shortAnswers.q: How does Anna feel when Elsa runs away?
shortAnswers.model: She is confused and sad, because she has lost her sister again. She still wants to help her.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Hans's plan fail?
shortAnswers.model: He thinks a kiss from him will save Anna, but he does not love her. Anna saves Elsa instead, and that act of love saves her.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if you had a secret like Elsa's?
shortAnswers.model: I would ask for help from someone I trust instead of keeping it alone. A secret is easier to carry with a friend.

gaps.line: Judy comes from a big family of rabbits in ___.
gaps.hint: the name of her home town

gaps.line: Judy moves to Zootopia and lives in a small cheap ___.
gaps.hint: a home in a big building

gaps.line: Nick sells ice lollies on the street with his friend ___.
Judy has only 48 hours to find the missing ___.
Bellwether uses a flower to make the animals go ___.

quiz.q: Why does Judy leave her family's farm?
options: She wants to see the city
She wants to be a police officer in Zootopia
quiz.why: She has wanted to be a police officer since she was a child.

quiz.q: Why does Nick help Judy with the case?
options: Judy records him breaking the law
He wants to find his friend
quiz.why: Judy records him talking about his illegal business, so he has to help her.

quiz.q: Why is the scene at the DMV funny?
options: The sloth is very slow and Nick enjoys it
quiz.why: Flash the sloth works very slowly, and Nick makes the wait even longer.

quotes.quote: Never let them see that they get to you.
quotes.note: Nick says it to Judy after a hard day, and it is the lesson he learned as a fox.

quotes.quote: Fear always works.
quotes.note: Bellwether says it at the end, and it explains her whole plan.

truefalse.s: Judy is a fox and Nick is a rabbit.
truefalse.fix: Judy is a rabbit and Nick is a fox.

truefalse.s: Judy is the first rabbit police officer in Zootopia.
Chief Bogo gives Judy the big case on her first day.
truefalse.fix: He gives her parking tickets and only later lets her take the case.

truefalse.s: Judy records Nick talking about his illegal business.
The missing animals are kept in a secret laboratory.
Mayor Lionheart is the real villain of the film.
truefalse.fix: Bellwether is behind the savage animals; Lionheart only hid what he found.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Judy want to be a police officer?
shortAnswers.model: She wants to help people, and she believes anyone can do any job in Zootopia. Her parents want her to stay on the farm.

shortAnswers.q: How does Nick feel when Judy talks about foxes?
shortAnswers.model: He feels hurt and angry, because she repeats what people say about foxes. He walks away from her.

shortAnswers.q: Why is Bellwether's plan dangerous for the city?
shortAnswers.model: It makes everyone afraid of predators and turns neighbour against neighbour. A city cannot work if everybody is afraid.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if everyone said you could not do your dream job?
shortAnswers.model: I would practise harder and find someone who supports me. I would show them what I can do.

gaps.line: Moana's father wants her to become the next ___ of the island.
Gramma Tala shows Moana the boats in a cave behind a ___.
Moana sails across the sea with a chicken called ___.
The island has no fish, and the plants are ___.
Te Ka is a big monster made of lava and ___.

quiz.q: Why does Moana sail away from her island?
options: She must return the heart to Te Fiti
quiz.why: The island is dying, and the heart must go back to Te Fiti.

quiz.q: Why does Maui first refuse to help Moana?
options: He is afraid and wants his hook back
quiz.why: He has lost his hook and he does not want to fight Te Ka without it.

quiz.q: Why does the ocean choose Moana?
options: She is kind and helps a baby turtle
quiz.why: As a baby she helps a turtle to the water, and the ocean sees her kind heart.

quotes.quote: I am Moana of Motunui.
quotes.note: Moana says it to Maui when she asks him to come with her.

quotes.quote: See the line where the sky meets the sea, it calls me.
quotes.note: She sings it in How Far I'll Go, when she wants to leave the island.

truefalse.s: Moana is the daughter of the chief of Motunui.
Maui is a young boy who lives on Moana's island.
truefalse.fix: Maui is a demigod who has been alone on an island for a thousand years.

truefalse.s: Gramma Tala tells Moana that her people were voyagers.
The heart of Te Fiti is a red jewel.
truefalse.fix: It is a green stone with a spiral on it.

truefalse.s: Moana gives the heart back to Te Fiti at the end.
Moana's father is happy when she leaves the island.
truefalse.fix: He is angry and afraid at first, but later he sails with her.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Moana's father not want her to sail?
shortAnswers.model: He is afraid of the ocean because he lost a friend there. He wants to keep his daughter safe on the island.

shortAnswers.q: How does Moana feel before she sails away?
shortAnswers.model: She is afraid and sad, because she is leaving her family. She also knows that the ocean is calling her.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Maui change his mind about helping Moana?
shortAnswers.model: He sees that she is brave and that she needs him. He also wants to be a hero again.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if the sea called you like that?
shortAnswers.model: I would be afraid, but I would follow it and take a friend. I would want to help my home.

gaps.line: Riley is eleven and her family moves from Minnesota to ___.
Joy and Sadness must find their way back to ___.
gaps.hint: the control room in Riley's head

gaps.line: When Bing Bong cries, his tears are ___.
Each memory is a ball whose colour shows the ___.
Riley sits on the couch and tells her parents she feels ___.

quiz.q: Why is Riley unhappy after the move?
options: She does not like her new school
She misses her friends, her house and her team
quiz.why: She has lost her old life in Minnesota, and nothing in San Francisco feels like home.

quiz.q: Why do Joy and Sadness have to work together?
options: Sadness is the only one who can help Riley feel better
quiz.why: Riley needs to be sad and talk about it, and only Sadness can start that.

quiz.q: Why do the personality islands fall?
options: The memories that hold them are lost
quiz.why: Without Joy and Sadness, the core memories lose their power and the islands break.

quotes.quote: I've got a good feeling about today.
quotes.note: Joy says it at the start, before the first day at the new school.

quotes.quote: Sadness, don't touch the memories.
quotes.note: Joy tries to keep Sadness away from the happy memories.

truefalse.s: Joy is the first emotion to appear in Riley's life.
Riley's parents are angry with her for being sad.
truefalse.fix: They listen to her and hug her, and they say they miss Minnesota too.

truefalse.s: Bing Bong is a real friend from Riley's school.
truefalse.fix: He is Riley's imaginary friend, and he lives in her memory.

truefalse.s: Riley plays ice hockey in Minnesota.
At the end Riley cries in front of her parents.
The film says that being sad is a bad thing.
truefalse.fix: It shows that sadness helps Riley get help and feel better.

shortAnswers.q: Why is Joy afraid of Sadness at first?
shortAnswers.model: She thinks Sadness makes Riley unhappy and that happy memories are the only good ones. She wants to keep Riley cheerful.

shortAnswers.q: How does Riley feel on her first day at school?
shortAnswers.model: She feels nervous and out of place, and she misses her old friends. When she talks about home, she cries.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Bing Bong stay behind in the memory dump?
shortAnswers.model: He knows that Joy must get back to Headquarters, and he cannot go with her. He chooses to help Riley instead of himself.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if your family moved to a new city?
shortAnswers.model: I would feel sad at first, and I would call my old friends. I would try one new thing every week.

gaps.line: Po works in his father's noodle shop and dreams about ___.
Oogway points at Po during the kung fu ___.
Shifu trains Po with dumplings because Po learns best with ___.
Tai Lung escapes from prison and wants the Dragon ___.
Mr. Ping says the secret ingredient is ___.

quiz.q: Why does Shifu not want Po to be the Dragon Warrior?
options: Po is clumsy and knows nothing about kung fu
quiz.why: Shifu trained the best fighters in the valley, and Po cannot even touch his toes.

quiz.q: Why does Po stay at the Jade Palace after Shifu sends him away?
options: He wants to see the Dragon Scroll
He wants to eat the palace food
quiz.why: He believes he was chosen for a reason, and he wants to see the scroll.

quiz.q: Why can Po fight Tai Lung at the end?
options: He learns the secret move from the scroll
He is himself and uses his own style
quiz.why: The scroll is empty, so Po fights as a panda who loves food — and it works.

quotes.quote: One often meets his destiny on the road he takes to avoid it.
quotes.note: Oogway says it to Shifu when Shifu wants to send Po home.

quotes.quote: There is no charge for awesomeness.
quotes.note: Po says it at the start of the film, when he dreams about being a hero.

truefalse.s: Po works in a noodle shop with his father.
Tai Lung is chosen as the Dragon Warrior.
truefalse.fix: Po is chosen; Tai Lung is the villain who wants the scroll.

truefalse.s: Shifu is Po's father.
truefalse.fix: Mr. Ping the goose is Po's father; Shifu is his teacher.

truefalse.s: The Dragon Scroll is empty and shows only a reflection.
Po uses a move called the Wuxi finger hold to beat Tai Lung.
Po learns kung fu easily from his first day at the palace.
truefalse.fix: He is clumsy and fails many times before he finds his own style.

shortAnswers.q: Why do the other masters not accept Po?
shortAnswers.model: They think a big, clumsy panda cannot be a warrior. They trained for years and he knows nothing.

shortAnswers.q: How does Po feel when he is chosen?
shortAnswers.model: He is shocked and very happy, but also afraid. He does not understand why Oogway chose him.

shortAnswers.q: Why does the empty scroll help Po?
shortAnswers.model: It shows him that there is no secret power outside himself. He only needs to believe in who he is.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do if nobody believed in you?
shortAnswers.model: I would keep practising and find my own way to do things. I would prove them wrong by working hard.

gaps.line: Bluey and Bingo play in the garden with a toy ___.
Dad is frozen with one foot in the air like a ___.
gaps.hint: a stone figure of a person

gaps.line: Mum tells Bluey that she must take ___ with her sister.
Bingo asks for a turn, but Bluey says ___.
Bluey's little sister is called ___.

quiz.q: Why does Bingo get upset?
options: Bluey will not give her a turn
quiz.why: Bingo only wants to play the game too, and Bluey keeps saying no.

quiz.q: Why does Bluey finally give Bingo a turn?
options: She sees that Bingo is sad and wants to play too
quiz.why: Bluey understands that the game is not fun if her sister is left out.

quiz.q: Why is the game better when everyone takes turns?
options: It is a real magic xylophone
Everyone plays together and takes turns
quiz.why: When they share, both sisters can freeze and be frozen, and the game goes on longer.

quotes.quote: Unfreeze me!
quotes.note: Dad says it while he is frozen, and the girls decide when to let him move.

quotes.quote: It's not fair!
quotes.note: Bingo says it when Bluey will not share the xylophone.

truefalse.s: The xylophone is a toy, and the magic is a game the family plays.
Bluey freezes Mum first.
truefalse.fix: She freezes Dad first, while he is walking in the garden.

truefalse.s: Bingo is Bluey's little sister.
Bingo is happy to watch and does not want a turn.
truefalse.fix: Bingo asks for a turn and gets upset when Bluey says no.

truefalse.s: Mum tells Bluey to share with her sister.
The xylophone belongs to Mum and is really magic.
truefalse.fix: It is a normal toy, and the magic is only in the game.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Bluey not want to give Bingo a turn?
shortAnswers.model: She is enjoying the game and she likes being the one with the power. She is afraid the game will stop if she shares.

shortAnswers.q: How does Bingo feel when Bluey says no?
shortAnswers.model: She feels left out and sad, because she only wants to play too. She stops enjoying the game.

shortAnswers.q: Why is the game better when everyone takes turns?
shortAnswers.model: Everyone can be the one who freezes and the one who is frozen. It is more fun when nobody is left out.

shortAnswers.q: What game would you play with a magic xylophone?
shortAnswers.model: I would freeze my brother for one minute and then let him freeze me. I would make a rule that nobody stays frozen for long.

gaps.line: Peppa and George watch the rain from the kitchen ___.
Mummy Pig says you must wear your ___ before you jump.
George jumps in the biggest puddle and gets very ___.
Daddy Pig jumps in a puddle and everybody ___.
Peppa's family all jump together and have a lot of ___.

quiz.q: Why do Peppa and George stay inside at the start?
quiz.why: The rain is too heavy, so they watch it from the window.

quiz.q: What rule does Mummy Pig give?
options: You must wear boots in the puddles
quiz.why: Boots keep their feet dry, and the rule is repeated twice in the episode.

quiz.q: Why does George cry?
options: The rain stops and he wants to stay outside
quiz.why: He loves the puddles, and the rain stopping means the game is over.

quotes.quote: It's only mud.
quotes.note: Daddy Pig says it when the children come home dirty, so nobody is in trouble.

quotes.quote: I love muddy puddles.
quotes.note: Peppa says it before they put on their boots.

truefalse.s: The story starts on a rainy day.
Peppa puts on her boots after she jumps in the puddles.
truefalse.fix: Mummy Pig makes them put on boots before they go outside.

truefalse.s: George jumps in the biggest puddle.
George is Peppa's big brother.
truefalse.fix: George is her little brother.

truefalse.s: Daddy Pig jumps in the puddles too.
The children must stay inside all day.
truefalse.fix: They go outside in boots and play in the puddles.

shortAnswers.q: Why do Peppa and George want to go outside?
shortAnswers.model: They see the rain and they want to jump in the puddles. For them, rain means a new game.

shortAnswers.q: How does George feel when the rain stops?
shortAnswers.model: He is unhappy, because he wants to stay outside and jump. He cries until he can play again.

shortAnswers.q: Why does Mummy Pig make a rule about boots?
shortAnswers.model: She wants the children to stay dry and clean, and mud is difficult to wash. It is a simple rule they can remember.

shortAnswers.q: What would you do on a rainy day?
shortAnswers.model: I would put on my boots and jump in the puddles, then go home for hot chocolate. I would not stay inside all day.
